verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The Government of India is not offering 3 months of free mobile recharge. The viral messages contain phishing links designed to steal personal data.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple fact-checking organisations and news outlets have repeatedly debunked the claim that Prime Minister Modi is offering 3 months of free mobile recharge. The government has not announced any such scheme, and the links circulating with these messages are fraudulent phishing scams designed to steal users' personal data.
